about.name: mission
about.text:
ODIN Diagnostics is a team of engineers, entrepreneurs and athletes working on concussion care.

Our mission is to improve concussion care to protect brain health. Finding a concussion early means treatment can start early, which helps prevent further damage after the injury.

We also aim to guide evidence-based treatment that reduces long-term effects.
